description: The plan marks 2.2 closed while 4.1.2 keeps citing it as the owner of its one remaining limit — the assistive-technology pass this report still owes. A limit that has gone is a level to raise, not a citation to keep; the report would otherwise understate the library on the day it improved. The case is written over whichever finding a row is leaning on TODAY, and it has moved three times for that reason: from 4.8, then from 4.37 on the night 4.37 closed, and then from 4.45 on the day the skeleton took a `paused` input and 2.2.2 rose to Supports with no finding left to name.
